Hi Andrew, Ethan,

Quick technical read on the procurement questions while we prepare commercial options: based on the spiky clinic traffic you described, our recommendation is to avoid a pure per-seat model. Two pragmatic packaging approaches we see work well:

1) Metered capacity commit + optional burst buffer
   - You commit to a monthly token / throughput baseline and we reserve dedicated nodes to meet latency SLOs.
   - Platform fee covers control plane, telemetry, automatic KV/prefix caching, and access to Redwoods’ private control plane.
   - Burst buffer allows temporary autoscale beyond the commit at a predefined premium rate.

2) Node-based licensing with autoscaling policy
   - License per inference node (gpu instance). Better for tightly predictable throughput.
   - Add-on: SRE retainer for live incident response and on-call runbook updates.

Platform fee notes:
- Components: control plane subscription, release patching, curated model catalog access, and analytics retention (30d standard).
- Amortization: we can amortize the platform fee across the contract term (standard is 12 or 24 months) and apply a smaller one-time starter credit to offset migration/validation work.

Support tiers (summary):
- Bronze: business hours email + 48h response, best-effort fixes.
- Silver: 24x5 email + 8h response for Sev2, 2h for Sev1 (regional oncall).
- Gold: 24x7 with named on-call rotation, proactive performance reviews, and quarterly runbook tests.

For compliance/SOC2 we can provide a redacted report and a list of our control mappings; attached is our deployment readiness checklist (high level) to help your infra team.

I’ll coordinate with Marissa on pricing buckets and put a draft term sheet together.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Andrew, Ethan, Monica,

Thanks 14. Based on Monica’s technical recap and the procurement questions, here are three commercial packages we commonly present. These are preliminary, ballpark ranges to help procurement decide which track to take. Final pricing will depend on actual qps/token profile and exact term.

Option A 5 (Starter & Validate) - 12 months
- Platform fee: $90k - $120k (amortizable monthly)
- Nodes / capacity: metered commit with 20% burst buffer; estimated $12k - $18k/month depending on baseline throughput
- Support: Silver included; Gold upgrade available as add-on ($6k/mo)
- One-time migration/SOW fee: $20k - $35k
- Overages: charged at 150% of unit rate, but we can cap overage exposure to +25% of committed spend in year one upon signature.

Option B 5 (Committed & Discounted) - 24 months
- Platform fee: $150k - $200k (amortizable) with a larger discount applied to long-term commit
- Nodes / capacity: deeper discount on reserved nodes; effective unit cost ~20-30% lower than meter
- Support: Silver + quarterly on-site or remote onboarding included
- One-time SOW: $10k - $25k (reduced)

Option C 5 (Self-managed Private)
- Lower platform fee: $50k - $80k (control plane license only)
- No reserved nodes; pay-as-you-go metering or bring-your-own-inference-nodes licensing
- Recommended SRE retainer: $8k - $15k/month for hands-on operational readiness and runbook maintenance

Next steps: we can convert Option A or B into a term sheet and provide an editable HelixCare term sheet (attached). If you want to accept a PO, we can update the term sheet to reflect invoicing cadence (monthly or upfront).

Let me know which option you want us to firm up and I’ll send a formal quote/term sheet.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
